Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TROWELS FOR USE IN FOUNDRIES 



1. Scope — Requirements for trowels for use in foundries. Irowels are used for making, finishing and 
repairing the moulds. 

2. Dimensions — As specified in Tables I to 5. 

3. Material 

3.1 Blade — Tool steel T 80, IS : 3749-1 966 'Specification for tools and die steels for coid work 1 . 

3.2 Tang— High tensiie steel St 58 — HT IS : 96U !962 'Specification for structural stee! (high tensile) 
( revised ) \ 

3.3 Handle — Phenolic moulding material Grade 2, IS: 1300-1966 'Specification for phenolic moulding 
materials ( second revision ) \ 

4. Assembly — The tang shall be rigidly joined with blade either by welding or rivetting. 

5. Coating 

5-1 Blades — Hard chromium as in 15:1337-1968 'Specification for hard chromium electroplated coatings 
on iron and steel (first revision) 9 * 

5.2 Handle — Lacquer coated. 

6. Hardness — HRC 50 to 55 on the blade. 

7. Tolerances 

7.1 Blade— Grade IT 14, IS : 919-1963 Recommendations for limits and fits for engineering (revised)'. 

7.2 Tang and Handle — Grade IT 16, IS: 919- 1963. 

8. General — Heat treated surfaces shall be free from cracks, burrs, scales, rust, etc. 

% Marking — The trowels shall be marked with the trade-mark or name of manufacturer and designation 
of the tool. 

9.1 ISI Certification Marking— Details available from the Indian Standards Institution, New Delhi I. 

9.2 The package shall be marked with the information given under 9 and 9.1. 

10. Packing — Wrapped separately in moisture-proof paper. Protective oil shall be applied on tang. 
Tools of the same type and size shall be placed in cartons containing twelve tools. Cartons may be placed 
; n w ooden boxes weighing not more than 50 kg overall. 

11. Supply — According to IS: 1387-1967 'General requirements for the supply of metallurgical materials 
(first revision)' . 



Adopted 30 December 1970 



© August 1971, ISI 



INDIAN STANDARDS INSTITUTION
